ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

More than 10 million developers build on it, from solo founders shipping over a weekend to teams and builders via Vercel, Lovable and Stripe, and every one of them reaches Supabase through a surface: an API, an auth flow, an SDK, or a Partner's product with Supabase integrated.

The current and next wave of software leans on those surfaces harder than any before it.

Agents now act on behalf of developers and end users, authentication has to work machine-to-machine as seamlessly as it once worked human-to-human, and independent platforms increasingly need to authenticate, delegate, and coordinate with each other without a person in the loop. For a platform built on Postgres with Auth, Compute, Storage and generated Data APIs at its core, the surfaces where Supabase meets Partners and their systems are some of the most important avenues that we own - this role owns these surfaces.

This role owns a focused portfolio of those Partners. Not the platform as a whole, but a small number of strategic Partners whose integrations you are accountable for making excellent. Success here is a product measure, not a commercial one: the integration is high quality, the developers who use it are well served, and it keeps improving. That means living close to those developers, obsessing over where the integration fails them, and turning what you learn into the roadmap. It is a product and engineering job first, because the best integrations are won in architecture reviews and pull requests, not in meetings.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Owning the success of a focused portfolio of strategic Partners, a small number of them rather than the platform as a whole. You are accountable for the outcome of each partnership: a high-quality integration that the developers who use it reach for, and that keeps getting better.

- Living close to the developers who use these integrations. Talking to them constantly, finding where each integration breaks down in real use, and building the roadmap from that signal rather than from a Partner's wishlist.

- Deciding the right integration model for each Partner: what Supabase owns, what the Partner owns, what you build jointly, and what stays open and Partner-agnostic, reading whether the two roadmaps run together or diverge and choosing accordingly.

- Working hands-on with each Partner's product and engineering counterparts to ship. Holding your own in an architecture review and a code-level design discussion, and turning strategy into shipped, high-quality integrations rather than long conversations.

- Setting the quality bar for what a great integration looks like, and building the mechanisms (documentation, tooling, guardrails, versioning) that hold every Partner to it as adoption scales.

- Defining what success looks like for each integration and measure it honestly: adoption by the developers who use it, integration quality, and reliability in real use. Using those signals to decide how deep to go with each Partner and where to push the integration next.

Description
About the Project
We're looking for native-level Portuguese (BR) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project.
The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio.
Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. 
What You'll Do
Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up
Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each
Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios
Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions
Your Recording Environment
Three things are required, and each is judged separately:
An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required - see below.
A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. 
A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording.
Minimum Required Gear
Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar.
Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar.
Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples - isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… 
Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets.
Technical Specification
You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications:
WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply - this level of technicality is required for this role.
Who We're Looking For
Native-level Portuguese (BR) speaker
A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style
A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above
Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc - anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio

title: Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy
description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple--districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will build and lead the communications, research, and narrative infrastructure necessary to make proportional representation one of the defining democracy reform movements of the 21st century.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will lead all communications, narrative development, public opinion research, digital engagement, media relations, and strategic communications efforts for the Proportional Representation Hub .

This executive will be responsible for shaping how policymakers, voters, journalists, funders, advocates, and opinion leaders understand proportional representation, in the context of other democracy reforms. They will oversee the communications strategies supporting federal, state, and local campaigns while simultaneously building a long-term narrative change effort to help transform the national conversation about democracy and move the idea of proportional representation from the margins to the mainstream.

The Vice President will oversee communications consultants, research firms, polling vendors, creative agencies, digital partners, media strategists, and public affairs consultants. They will also help build communications capacity throughout the broader democracy reform ecosystem, providing strategic guidance and technical support to allied organizations and campaign partners.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence – Fashion & Luxury AI Venture | BIANCO VENTURES
description:
Bianco Ventures è un company builder verticale dedicato alla creazione di startup software B2B per il mondo Fashion & Luxury. Uniamo capitale, execution e conoscenza profonda del mercato fin dal primo giorno, insieme a partner come Deloitte, GELLIFY e ARAD, per costruire nuove imprese con chi conosce il settore dall'interno.
Non siamo un fondo. Non siamo un acceleratore. Costruiamo imprese vere, partendo da problemi veri.
La venture oggetto di questa ricerca è la prima iniziativa live del nostro ecosistema. Stiamo cercando la persona che la guidi.
La sfida
Nelle organizzazioni retail distribuite, decine, centinaia di punti vendita, mercati diversi, team locali con autonomia operativa, il coordinamento tra struttura centrale e rete è uno dei problemi più persistenti e ancora poco risolti dalla tecnologia.
Le linee guida partono dall'HQ. Cosa succede dopo è spesso invisibile. L'execution reale, la qualità con cui le direttive diventano azione nei singoli store, viene misurata tardi, se viene misurata. I dati ci sono, ma sono frammentati, manuali, non strutturati.
Questo è il problema che stiamo affrontando.
La venture
Stiamo costruendo una piattaforma B2B software e AI focalizzata sulla retail execution e sull'operational intelligence per il Fashion, il Luxury e il Retail mid-market.
La venture nasce da un'analisi concreta del mercato e da interlocuzioni dirette con i decision maker del settore. La tesi di mercato è sviluppata. La value proposition iniziale è strutturata. Il problema è reale e ancora largamente irrisolto dagli strumenti oggi disponibili.
Siamo in fase early-stage. Il prodotto e il modello di business devono ancora essere validati e costruiti, questa è esattamente la ragione per cui stiamo cercando chi voglia farlo.
Il ruolo
Cerchiamo un'Entrepreneur in Residence che agisca come founder operativa/o della venture.
Non si tratta di un incarico consulenziale. Non è un ruolo di product management interno. Non è innovation management.
È ownership reale di un'impresa in costruzione: dalla customer discovery alla prima revenue, dalla definizione del prodotto alla creazione del team, dal go-to-market alla preparazione allo spin-off.
Avrai autonomia concreta. Avrai il supporto di un ecosistema attivo. Avrai accesso a stakeholder industriali che raramente si trovano nella stessa stanza.
Cosa farai nei primi 6-9 mesi
Nei primi mesi costruirai le fondamenta operative e commerciali della venture. In concreto:

• Approfondirai la customer discovery, intervistando Retail Director, Head of VM, COO e altri decision maker del settore, per validare il problema e misurare la willingness to pay

• Raffinerai la value proposition in dialogo con il mercato reale, non con ipotesi interne

• Coordinerai la costruzione dell'MVP con il team tecnologico, definendo le priorità di prodotto in funzione di ciò che hai imparato sul campo

• Progetterai e gestirai i primi pilot con brand selezionati, raccogliendo evidenze qualitative e quantitative

• Definirai il modello commerciale (pricing, segmentazione, struttura contrattuale) partendo dai dati, non da benchmark generici

• Costruirai il go-to-market iniziale e acquisirai i primi clienti paganti

• Coordinerai partner tecnologici, fornitori e risorse dedicate

• Definirai KPI e milestone della venture e le presenterai agli stakeholder e ai potenziali investitori

• Costruirai il primo team intorno alla venture

• Preparerai la società allo spin-off e al fundraising seed
Chi cerchiamo
Consideriamo profili con 5-10 anni di esperienza che abbiano lavorato in almeno uno di questi ambiti: startup early-stage, venture building, product management B2B, growth, SaaS enterprise, retail tech, AI o innovation.
Quello che non è negoziabile:

• Capacità di condurre customer discovery in contesti enterprise, sapere ascoltare, sapere sintetizzare, sapere cambiare idea quando i dati lo richiedono

• Attitudine commerciale: saper portare una soluzione davanti a un buyer, gestire il ciclo di vendita, chiudere

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.

• Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.

• Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep
